title: Payout processing windows
content: Payouts may sit in processing while manual review, verification checks, or payment partner settlement complete. Staff must not promise a completion time unless the status is confirmed in back-office tooling. Typical review windows are up to 24 hours, but exceptions exist.

title: Suspected account compromise
content: When a customer reports unauthorised access, a login they do not recognise, or a lost 2FA device, the case must be routed to identity verification. Staff must not disable 2FA or reset credentials over chat or email outside the documented verification flow.

title: Account data disclosure limits
content: Automated systems and staff must not disclose account balance, transaction history, statements, or other account-specific financial data except through authenticated product surfaces or an approved secure workflow.
